title: A Multiplayer Browser RPG with AI-Powered Mechanics
author: ARWorlds_umut
selftext:
Hi folks!

Realms Uncharted is ready for your feedback!

It is a classic browser based multiplayer RPG like the good old GameForge games of the early 2000s. 

# Where is the AI?

Most RPG mechanics are backed with LLM text and image generation. You can generate locations, weapons, enemies, and player avatars.

# What else is in the game?

You can travel to any player generated world, battle with all generated enemies, and trade generated weapons with other players.

I want to have an ever-growing world for players to create, explore, and interact. Find powerful items and easy to farm enemies in distant locations.

I still got to figure out how to increase the influence of players and the world on the LLM generation, have more diversity, and less luck. 

# How to play?

It's still in early alpha but feel free to check it out here: http://realmsuncharted.app

The first 10 generations are free for every player. Go give it a try! Leave a comment if you need more.

# Feedback!

Please let me know what you think about it. I'd like to hear some feedback. What other AI mechanics would suit such a game? You can comment here or use the in-game feedback.

Thanks to those who gave feedback on my now deleted post from last weekend. I was able to fix so many issues.

Best

P.S. Please ignore the balance issues. It's on the roadmap.

comments.author: abutun
comments.body: Seems interesting and good but without a real action it doesn’t feel like a real game unfortunately.

replies.author: ARWorlds_umut
replies.body: I see your point. I used to play such games growing up, maybe the genre is just too dated. Do you have any ideas on how to bring in some more action? I don't want to just scrap the idea before exploring more LLM RPG elements.

replies.author: abutun
replies.body:
Maybe you can turn the battles into 2d scenes and make the battle more realistic.

I was playing Heroes III, a turn based strategy game, back in 99 and the battle scenes was like that.

When you encounter a battle situation you just simply load a new screen with 2d characters and  fight scene in action.

replies.author: ARWorlds_umut
replies.body: Gotcha, I'll try a few things over the weekend.

comments.author: Charming_Research673
comments.body: Full of bugs. Stats never update, gold never updates, XP, health, etc, never updates. Sell items, gold doesn't update. Heal with items, health doesn't update. Defeat enemies, xp doesn't update. Die, still no updates. Get loot, doesn't end up in inventory. You have a massive un-working game interface with no working functionality, and you're actively trying to charge money for it.

replies.author: ARWorlds_umut
replies.body:
Thanks for giving it a try. I had a few playtesters and we spent the past few days fixing bugs. I'll see what went wrong with your account, maybe there is a problem we have not seen yet. 

The money is only covering the image generation costs after you exhaust your free credits. And I already stated that I can give more credits for free if you need.

comments.author: KefkeWren
comments.body: Is it intentional that expeditions only give gold and items, and not experience? It's definitely doable to level just by going to the arena and buying experience potions, but it seems pretty rough with the amounts not scaling.
